description.value: The Liz Stubbs Cutting Garden is a volunteer-tended flower garden tucked alongside the ocean within the nine-acre Filberg Park in Comox, named for a longtime local supporter of the park. Seasonal blooms grown from seed are arranged throughout the adjacent heritage lodge, and fresh bouquets are sold from a red flower cart near the on-site Summer Kitchen. The surrounding park is a free, publicly accessible green space featuring rare trees, rhododendrons, ocean views, and a heritage lodge — a pleasant off-bike stop on Vancouver Island.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names a specific sub-feature ('Liz Stubbs Cutting Garden') within the broader Filberg Park in Comox, BC. The website confirms the garden's existence and describes it as a volunteer-run flower garden alongside the ocean within the 9-acre park. Contact details (address, phone) are drawn from the website's contact page since OSM provides none; the website also confirms free admission and mentions on-site food service at the Summer Kitchen. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM record covers only the Liz Stubbs Cutting Garden, a sub-feature of Filberg Park — the broader park (Filberg Heritage Lodge and Park) may warrant its own directory entry and could produce a duplicate.
No address or phone in OSM tags; both were sourced exclusively from the website contact page.
Website is for the parent organization (Filberg Heritage Lodge and Park Association), not specifically for the cutting garden.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The OSM record represents a named sub-feature (a cutting garden) within the larger Filberg Park rather than the park itself; a directory entry for Filberg Park as a whole would be more useful and comprehensive for touring cyclists. Recommend reviewing whether a separate OSM record exists for the parent park to avoid a partial or duplicative listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Park admission is free and open daily. The website notes the park closes the week before and after the annual Filberg Festival. The Filberg Park is part of the Vancouver Island Garden Trail.

Café or food on site.detail: Filberg Summer Kitchen is located on site immediately adjacent to the cutting garden; website references it as a place to 'grab a bite to eat' and lists a dedicated phone line (250.339.2750)

wow_evidence: Volunteer-tended oceanside cutting garden in Filberg Park, with bouquets sold from a flower cart; charming.
blurb: Seaside cutting garden in Comox's Filberg Park, with a bouquet cart in summer.
